translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Bzkq Apuku Melrmqgung Kcng Tzvecpx-lzbqmqng Mz Gct

content.text: Leplz nengeng, lalztqmamu mz nzalvztr-krnge,
Mz nzxlr-angidr-krmamu natqngeng.
Sa naryapwxbo bamu mz nzycmne-ebzpxngr.
X sa nayokaetipxbo dalr mzli kc bqnc kx trgalr kxrkrlz.
Da lcng tqxlrpeku x tqkrlzpeku
Murde nzpipem melrmqgung bagu.
Bzkq yrlq-kapqbzkung mz doa negung,
A' nayapwxtibzku badr.
Yawe yrlqbzle loukxtr scde mz lr Israel,
Mz nzka-krbzle natqde mz nqvi lr Jekop.
X rngidrlvz-ngrbzle mz melrmqgu lcng
Kx na-alvztr-ngrdr doa nedrng mz lou lcng.
Murde nayrlqlr lou lcng,
X na-alvztr-kzpzlr mz doa nedrng.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, nrpr ngr doa amrlx na-abrtrpzlr drtwrdr mz Gct,
X na-aoti drtwrdr da kxnzkctipxng kcng tqalele mz nzvz-nqblq-krdr natqdeng.
X bzkq na-apulr melrmqdrng kcng nardr tqmqngi x tzxpqbrlr-ngrdr Gct.
Trtegu lcng nabzdr bao x nzvecpx-lzbqmqng bade.
Mzli kc bqnc kzdung lr Israel, ncblo ngr vea nedrng nzoliq-angidrpeng mz popz' x nipna scdrng,
A' mz zbq kc navecpengr, sc tzdwapeng.
Murde trnzatutrlru Nzesz'tikr Drtwrdr badr Gct,
X nzpxtxpx-ngrdr lou scdeng.
Kxmule-esz' nzmcpelr zmatq ngr Gct,
A' trmatqu mz drtwrdr da kxnzkctipxng kcng tqaleleng mrkc Ijipt.
Akipxle Prla Bla x mz nrlarde rlilr atule apule nztukr drkq,
Mz nzmailzo-krde leplz nedeng elr.
X mz nzvz-krdr ngrlx, mailzle nidr mz dcbz,
X nyr rtwayzbz badr mz nrlckxbq.
Mzli kc tzmnc-ngrdr lzke, amrplxtrpzle rplz
Kx yrlepx-ngrm lue x ningali.
Murde narmnqng x drtwrdr naesatxpx zpwx
Mz lue lc tqkabzle badr, tqxplrm nzyrle-krde.
Kxmule-esz', a' vz zvz nzatrkati-krdr Gct kc tqmyalz-esz'ngr,
Mz nzale-krdr alwx x nzxpqbrlr-ngrdr nide.
Mz nzmqngikr nabzdr nzabzlr nzatalzngr Gct,
Mz nzka-krbzle dakxnzng kx naesapxngr drtwrdr.
Nzpibqtilr Gct, nzrpilr kx,
“Kxmule-esz' luplxtrle rplz x lue yrlepx-katom elr,
A' rblxbz bade nzrka-krmle nagu dakxnzng,
Mz nzaclve-krde nigu leplz nedeng.”
Yawe kx xlrle kc nzycmne-krdr, drtwrde trmrlzlzpuu.
X zngya ngr drtwrde kc tzapqtr-zlwzbzlr.
Murde trnzlxngitilru nide,
X drtwrdr trnzabrtrpwzlru bade mz nzaclve-krde nidr.
Kxmule-esz', a' lvxpxbzle bongavz,
Mz nzatwzlro-krmle badr dakxnzng ngr Heven.
X mzli lcde, leplz txneng nzmung dakxnzng nan enjrl,
Mz nzangidati-krbz Gct zbrtale ngr nelzdr.
X mz zmatq ngrde kz
Sc tqawqpele nenq tonga x trlaki.
X nenq lcng li nzrtwzmqng blzmr kio,
X nzyrlwrne-krdr apule drta' ngr prla.
Kio lcng nztatiomqng mz drtc'
O-ngalele ma nyzdrng.
Gct kabzle badr nikeng nzsuti zlwz drtwrdr.
Nzngqdr x nelzdr krlc.
Kxmule-esz', a' drtwrdr tresapxu.
X mzli lc tzmube-ngrdr,
Gct sc tqnibqtipebzle obla nedr kcng tzxplrng,
Mz nzngyatikr drtwrde nidr.
Kxmule-esz' Gct ayrplapx-katole nidr mz alwx ngrdrng, a' sc tzale-zvzng alwx.
X kxmule-esz' nzmcpelr nzale-krde da kxnzkctipxng, a' trnzlxngitilru nide.
Zbz sc tqnibq-anipele nidr
Mz nzapusr-krdeleng lue kc tqmilqpx mz leu r nya x tqmrbro mz drtc'.
Kx nibqle kcng, opxm kx drtwr kxnzlubeng sc tqyzlu-mopwz bade,
Mz nzplzpx-krbzlr alwx ngrdr x nzkrka'-krbzlr bade.
X opxm kz kx dctipx mou drtwrdr kx Gct kc tqrninr nide butqbr nyzdr,
Kc tqarlapx-zvzle nidr.
Kxmule-esz', a' nzpokiatilr nide
Mz nzrpi-krbzlr bade kx nzmrlztilr nide.
Kxmule-esz' nabzdr bao,
X trnzatutrlru Nzesz'tikr Drtwrdr badr,
A' trodatileu nidr, murde yckqti mou drtwrde nidr x ipqpxbzle alwx ngrdrng.
X nzwrde kqlu kx ngyatingr drtwrde nidr, a' lolvztxde zngya ngr drtwrde.
Murde krlzle kx nidr leplz x nzkrlzlr nzbzngr,
Mz nzapu-krdr nenq kc tqwq x sc tqamaneope.
Nzwrde kqlu lzke nzxpqbrlr-ngrdr nide,
Mz nzavzti-krbzlr drtwrde.
Zvz nzale-ebir-krdr da kx nzangyati-ngrbzlr drtwrde,
Mz drtwrdr kx lctr-zvzbz mz Gct kc Tqtr-esz'ngr.
Mrbrtr mz drtwrdr zmatq ngrde
Mz nzarlapx-krde nidr mz mq enqmi rdrng.
Mzli kc tqale-ngrde da kxnzkctipxng
Mz nzvzmipx-krde nidr Ijipt.
X mzli kc tzmnc-ngrdr Ijipt, ngi-batrpzle lue kxetung nzlrtipx-krdr mepyr,
Murde lr Ijipt ma tzrmnqng lue.
Atwzlr-ngrmle frck kxkqlu kx na-atrkatilr mrnyzdr,
X mc kxkqlu kx namakxtilr nidr.
Nibqtibzle kzu, sip, x gout nedrng
Mz kzdq zyagox kxtrka.
X mz nibrde atwzlr-ngrmle trlipu kxetu,
Mz nzamzti-krbzle nounc x dalr nrlanc nyzdrng mz nzatatio-krmleleng muli-aes.
Zbz sc tqatwzlrpe-ngrmle kionabr
Mz nzngqti-krdr dakxnzng amrlx kx nzlutinepwzng mz nrlanc.
X mz nzngyati-zlwzkr drtwrde lr Ijipt kcng tzakxputilr leplz nedeng,
Atwzlr-ngrmle enjrl kxnzkqlung mz nzpulio-krmlr nyr mz nzayrplapx-krdeleng.
Trlolvzleu zngya ngr drtwrde,
A' xplr-esz'ngr apule nubla ngr lue mz nznibqti-krde nidr.
Nibqtibzle doa ncblo kx ayrnrngr nedrng,
Nidr kcng tzvzpxmqng mz nqvi lr Ham, doa ne Noa.
Mz nibrde sc tqrtwayzpebz mz leplz nedeng mz nzrlasz-krdr Ijipt.
X mailztrle nidr lzke mz nzapu-krdr sip nedeng.
Aclve-angidrle nidr, x trnzmwxlru.
A' aboobzle enqmi rdrng amrlx prla.
X mz nibrde sc tqvzmitr-atele nidr mz drtc' kxtr nyzde, Kenan,
Mrkc tqtungr Newz Saeon, kx nztwz mz zmatq ngr nzaovxio-krde.
Maneutipxle leplz kxnzmnc-mrbrng mrlcde, mz nzvztrkr leplz nedeng mz drtc' lc.
X sc tqakipxpebzle drtc' lc mz neidu lr Israel kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li, x nzmncpx-alzupq'ng mz ma nyzdr.

content: Mzli Kc Tzmnc-ngrdr Kenan 78:55 Josua; Kxnzryrlqng Drtwr; 1 Samwel; 2 Samwel

content.text: Kxmule-esz' nzmncpeng mz drtc' kxtr, a' sc tzycmne-plztitrlr
x nzxpqbrlr-ngrdr Gct kc tqrninr mz nzpxtxpx-krdr natqdeng.
Leplz lcng nzapulr melrmqdr kcng bqnc mz nzesablqti-krdr nide x nzvecpx-lzbq-krmlr bade.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, trpengr kx brti drtwrde nidr.
Nzangyatibzlr drtwrde mz nzangio-krdr kx trngiu Yawe Gct angidr,
X mz nzyrngzo-krbzlr mz mqngr da kxnzlz.
Kx mcle da lcng tzaletilr, ngyati zlwz drtwrde leplz nedeng,
X sc tqpxtxpxpe-ngrde nidr.
Rlasz-pnzle Tentkxtr nyzde kc mztea Saelc, mz drtc' nyz Efrem.
Mrkc tzmnc-kai-ngrdr badr leplz nedeng.
X rlr-ngrbzle mz enqmi nztwz-krdr Bokis kc tqyclz-ngrm Nzesz'tikr Drtwrdr Badr,
Kc tqngi rkx ngr zmatq x nzmyapx-esz'ngr-krde.
X mz nzngyati-zlwzkr drtwrde leplz nedeng,
Rlr-ngrbzle mz enqmi rdrng nznibqti-krdr nidr.
X obla nedrng amrlx nzbzting mz vea,
X olvi nedrng trpengr obla kx naryrlzting.
Pris nedrng nzbzti-kzng mz vea,
X olvz ngrdr nzmwxlr-zlwzng x trpnzngr mzli kx nayrnimi-ngrdr namz ngrdr.
Mz nibrde, mz drtwrdr opxm kx Kxetu apule ncblo kx melz-atem
Mz nzmwingr mz nzrmnq-krde waen.
X mzli lcpwz aovxiole enqmi rdeng,
Mz nzamyati-alo-krbzle drtqdr.

content: Gct Mcpxle Neidu Lr Judz, Newz Saeon, X Devet 78:66 1 Samwel 16:11-12

content.text: Gct trsutiu drtwrde doa neng Josip,
X sc tqrlaszpele drtc' nyz Efrem, kzdq mrlxde.
A' mcpx-alzule neidu lr Judz,
Mz nzmnc-krde Newz Saeon, kc tqmrlz-zlwzbz bade.
Mrlc dekc tqwztio-ngrde Mrkc Tqtr murde nayc alo elr,
Da kc tqwai nzyc-alokr Heven x nrlc.
X mcpx-kzle Devet kx nawztrpz bade.
X kapxmle nide mz nzaclve-krde sip neng trtede,
Murde nanginide king r lr Israel,
Mz nzaclve-krde leplz neng Gct.
X nzaclvekr Devet nidr tubq,
Mz nzmailz-zpwx-krde nidr.
